description: Forwards Done / Snooze taps on Household Tasks phone notifications (TASK_DONE_<id>_<date>, TASK_SNOOZE_<id>_<date>) to the Tasks service, which marks that exact occurrence and ignores stale taps. Sends the tapping person's HA user id so the service can record who did it (HA_DEVICE_PEOPLE in /opt/stacks/tasks/.env).
